ga_hope_gpa.description: HOPE GPA: core courses grades 9-12 on a flat 4.0 scale; +0.5 for B-F grades in AP, IB and dual enrollment core courses; no rounding.

programs.name: HOPE Scholarship
programs.summary: Tuition help at Georgia public and eligible private colleges for students with a 3.0 HOPE GPA and 4 rigor courses.

award.summary: Per-credit-hour amount set each year by college (e.g. about $5,017 a semester at UGA in 2026-27); flat $2,985 a semester at private colleges.

programs.name: Zell Miller Scholarship
programs.summary: Full standard tuition at Georgia public colleges for students with a 3.7 HOPE GPA, 4 rigor courses and a 1200 SAT or 25 ACT.

award.summary: 100% of standard tuition at public colleges.

deadlines.title: File the 2028-29 FAFSA (needed for Pell Grants; also counts for HOPE)
documents: Student and parent StudentAid.gov accounts (FSA IDs)

deadlines.title: Complete the GSFAPP on GAfutures (alternative to the FAFSA for HOPE and Zell)

verification.note: DRAFT from third-party summaries. Every rule, amount and date must be verified with GSFC before this pack moves to review. GSFC's rigor-course list is broader than AP/IB/DE (it also names some advanced math, science and foreign-language courses); model that before beta.
